title: How to Recruit Affiliates at Scale: live Alfie demo hosted by Dustin Howes
summary: Dustin Howes hosts a live School of Chaos webinar where the XP Flow team demos Alfie, an AI tool that finds, scores and emails affiliates from just a brand URL. Dustin's own contributions are framing: affiliate recruitment has been spreadsheet work, and AI should enhance partnership managers rather than replace them. Most substantive material comes from guests Matt and Beth.

principles.text: Manual affiliate recruitment (spreadsheets, guessing domains, cold emails to generic inboxes) is the old default that automation should replace.
principles.quote: I've spent 17 years in the affiliate space working out of spreadsheets, guessing at domains and firing emails into info at boxes that nobody reads.

principles.text: Show real, unscripted product demos on a blank account, because polished demos where nothing breaks aren't credible.
principles.quote: Most product webinars are going to show you this beautiful demo that really doesn't exist and nothing ever breaks.

principles.text: AI in affiliate management should enhance the partnership manager, not replace the human relationship work.
principles.quote: This is an enhancer, not a replacement. And that's what this industry is leaning towards.
